title: thlaspi cardamine

It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to act as a digestive aid and to reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Thlaspi cardamine include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being.
